name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
description: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 provides guidance to industry, government agencies, and other organizations to manage and reduce cybersecurity risks.

functions.name: Govern
functions.description: The organization’s cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored.

categories.name: Organizational Context
categories.description: The circumstances — mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements — surrounding the organization’s cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood.

subcategories.title: Organizational Mission & Objectives
subcategories.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.

subcategories.title: Internal & External Stakeholders
subcategories.description: Internal and external stakeholders and their cybersecurity expectations and requirements are understood.

subcategories.title: Legal, Regulatory & Contractual Requirements
subcategories.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity — including privacy and civil liberties obligations — are understood and managed.

subcategories.title: Critical Services & Dependencies
subcategories.description: Critical services and their supporting assets and dependencies are identified and prioritized.

subcategories.title: Outcomes & Capabilities Alignment
subcategories.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood.

categories.name: Risk Management Strategy
categories.description: The organization’s priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions.

subcategories.title: Risk Management Objectives
subcategories.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.

subcategories.title: Risk Appetite & Tolerance
subcategories.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained.

subcategories.title: Standardized Risk Assessment
subcategories.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes.

subcategories.title: Strategic Direction Integration
subcategories.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response is established and communicated.

subcategories.title: Lines of Communication
subcategories.description: Lines of communication across the organization for cybersecurity risk management are established and maintained.

subcategories.title: Standardized Risk Response Framework
subcategories.description: A standardized and documented process for determining organizational risk response is established and maintained.

subcategories.title: Strategic Opportunities Identification
subcategories.description: Strategic opportunities (positive risks) related to cybersecurity are identified and considered.

categories.name: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
categories.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated.

subcategories.title: Leadership Accountability
subcategories.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk.

subcategories.title: Roles & Responsibilities Defined
subcategories.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, and enforced.

subcategories.title: Adequate Resource Allocation
subcategories.description: Adequate resources are allocated to implement and maintain cybersecurity risk management.

subcategories.title: Cybersecurity in HR Practices
subcategories.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices.

categories.name: Policy
categories.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, approved, delivered, and enforced.

subcategories.title: Policy Establishment & Approval
subcategories.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risk is established, approved, and communicated.

subcategories.title: Policy Review & Updates
subcategories.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risk is reviewed, updated, and communicated periodically.

categories.name: Oversight
categories.description: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are evaluated to inform direction.

subcategories.title: Strategy Evaluation
subcategories.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy.

subcategories.title: Management Performance Review
subcategories.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed.

subcategories.title: Execution Oversight
subcategories.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management execution is overseen.

categories.name: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
categories.description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved.

subcategories.title: Supply Chain Risk Program
subcategories.description: A supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, and policies are established and approved.

subcategories.title: Supplier Due Diligence
subcategories.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality.

subcategories.title: Contractual Security Requirements
subcategories.description: Contracts with suppliers include cybersecurity requirements consistent with organizational risk.

functions.name: Identify
functions.description: The organization’s current cybersecurity risks are understood.

categories.name: Asset Management
categories.description: Assets (devices, data, software, systems, facilities, and personnel) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed.

subcategories.title: Hardware Inventory
subcategories.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained.

subcategories.title: Software Inventory
subcategories.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.

subcategories.title: Network & Data Flow Mapping
subcategories.description: Representations of the organization’s authorized network communication and data flows are maintained.

subcategories.title: Asset Prioritization
subcategories.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, and organizational value.

subcategories.title: Data & Information Inventory
subcategories.description: Inventories of data and information systems are maintained.

categories.name: Risk Assessment
categories.description: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization.

subcategories.title: Vulnerability Identification
subcategories.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.

subcategories.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence
subcategories.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.

subcategories.title: Internal & External Threats
subcategories.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded.

subcategories.title: Risk Calculation & Prioritization
subcategories.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to determine risk.

categories.name: Improvement
categories.description: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, assets, and activities are identified.

subcategories.title: Post-Incident Evaluation
subcategories.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations of operational performance, assessments, and incidents.

subcategories.title: Security Program Updates
subcategories.description: Cybersecurity risk management plans are updated based on identified improvements.

functions.name: Protect
functions.description: Safeguards to manage the organization’s cybersecurity risks are used.

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
categories.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access.

subcategories.title: Identity Credential Issuance
subcategories.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization.

subcategories.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
subcategories.description: Identities are authenticated, asserted, and bound to credentials based on risk (e.g., MFA).

subcategories.title: Least Privilege & RBAC Access
subcategories.description: Users, services, and hardware are granted access to physical and logical assets based on least privilege and separation of duties.

subcategories.title: Identity Access Revocation
subcategories.description: Identity assertion and access permissions are revoked upon termination or role change.

subcategories.title: Privileged Access Management
subcategories.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are managed with elevated controls for privileged roles.

categories.name: Awareness and Training
categories.description: The organization’s personnel are provided cybersecurity awareness and training to perform their cybersecurity-related duties and responsibilities.

subcategories.title: Security Awareness Training
subcategories.description: Personnel are provided cybersecurity awareness education upon onboarding and periodically.

subcategories.title: Specialized Role Training
subcategories.description: Individuals in specialized cybersecurity roles receive appropriate technical training.

categories.name: Data Security
categories.description: Data is managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.

subcategories.title: Data-at-Rest Encryption
subcategories.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected.

subcategories.title: Data-in-Transit Encryption
subcategories.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.

subcategories.title: Data Leakage Prevention
subcategories.description: Protections against data leaks and unauthorized exfiltration are implemented.

subcategories.title: Data Backups & Verification
subcategories.description: Backups of data and configurations are conducted, maintained, tested, and protected.

categories.name: Platform Security
categories.description: The hardware, software, and services of platforms are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy.

subcategories.title: Configuration Baselines
subcategories.description: Configuration baselines for systems and hardware are established, maintained, and enforced.

subcategories.title: Software Patching & Updates
subcategories.description: Software is maintained, replaced, or updated according to vulnerability and patch management policies.

subcategories.title: Log Generation & Retention
subcategories.description: Logs recording system, security, and audit events are generated, aggregated, and retained.

categories.name: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
categories.description: Security architectures are managed to protect organization assets and operations against disruption.

subcategories.title: Network Architecture & Segmentation
subcategories.description: Networks and communication channels are protected and segmented.

subcategories.title: Environmental & Hardware Redundancy
subcategories.description: The organization’s technology infrastructure is designed with appropriate resilience and redundancy.

functions.name: Detect
functions.description: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed.

categories.name: Continuous Monitoring
categories.description: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events.

subcategories.title: Network & Endpoint Monitoring
subcategories.description: Networks and environments are monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events and malicious code.

subcategories.title: Personnel & Account Monitoring
subcategories.description: Personnel activity and account usage are monitored for anomalous or unauthorized actions.

subcategories.title: External Service Provider Monitoring
subcategories.description: External service provider activities are monitored for cybersecurity compliance.

subcategories.title: Continuous Vulnerability Scanning
subcategories.description: Computing assets are scanned regularly for known vulnerabilities.

categories.name: Adverse Event Analysis
categories.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse cybersecurity events are analyzed.

subcategories.title: Alert Correlation & Triage
subcategories.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to understand attack targets and methods.

subcategories.title: Incident Impact Determination
subcategories.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources to determine event scope and impact.

subcategories.title: Incident Escalation
subcategories.description: Cybersecurity event criteria for escalation are defined and executed.

functions.name: Respond
functions.description: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken.

categories.name: Incident Management
categories.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed.

subcategories.title: Incident Response Plan Execution
subcategories.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

subcategories.title: Incident Categorization & Prioritization
subcategories.description: Incidents are categorized and prioritized based on impact.

categories.name: Incident Analysis
categories.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics.

subcategories.title: Forensic Investigation
subcategories.description: Analysis is performed to determine root cause and preserve evidence.

subcategories.title: Incident Containment Actions
subcategories.description: Actions are taken to contain cybersecurity incidents and prevent spread.

categories.name: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
categories.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders.

subcategories.title: Stakeholder Notification
subcategories.description: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents according to established criteria.

subcategories.title: Regulatory & Legal Notification
subcategories.description: Regulatory and law enforcement authorities are notified as required.

categories.name: Incident Mitigation
categories.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects.

subcategories.title: Incident Eradication
subcategories.description: Incidents are contained and eradicated to prevent further damage.

subcategories.title: Vulnerability Remediation
subcategories.description: Incidents are mitigated and newly identified vulnerabilities are remediated.

functions.name: Recover
functions.description: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored.

categories.name: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
categories.description: Restoration activities are performed to maintain and restore systems and services.

subcategories.title: Disaster Recovery Execution
subcategories.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed.

subcategories.title: System Restoration & Validation
subcategories.description: Restoration activities are verified before returning assets to production.

categories.name: Incident Recovery Communication
categories.description: Restoration activities and progress are coordinated and communicated.

subcategories.title: Recovery Status Communication
subcategories.description: Recovery activities and progress are communicated to internal and external stakeholders.
